name: Planes Method
aliases: RealityEngine Volume Rendering with CPU Compositing
definition: A volume rendering algorithm that utilizes 3D texture map hardware to render volumetric datasets, combining texture mapping for resampling with CPU-based raycasting for shading and classification.
summary: The Planes Method is a hardware-accelerated volume rendering technique that resamples volumetric data into planes for CPU-based shading and compositing, offering higher image quality and consistent performance for perspective projections compared to Shear-Warp.
